question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank No. 3.
solution: The correct answer is **"someone."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Someone"** refers to an unspecified or unknown person. (एक अनिर्दिष्ट या अज्ञात व्यक्ति)\ • **Example**: ***Someone**__ left their bag on the bus.* • It is used when referring to a person whose identity is not known or specified. • The word is a pronoun and can be used in place of a name or noun referring to a person. • The correct answer is Option 3. • Correct passage: He __opened__ his eyes. Moonlight was shining __through__ the bars on the window. And __**someone**__ was goggling through the ______ (4) ______ at him: a freckle-faced, red-haired, long-nosed someone. Ron Weasley was outside Harry's ______ (5) _______.​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Option 1, "sometimes"**, refers to a frequency of occurrence, meaning "at times". (कुछ मौकों पर; कभी-कभी) • **Option 2, "somewhere",** refers to a location that is unspecified or unknown. (स्‍थान पर/में/(को) जो आपको नहीं मालूम या जिसका नाम आप नहीं बताते; कहीं) • **Option 4, "somewhat"**, means to a moderate extent or degree. (किसी हद तक; कुछ-कुछ) 45:Tdd4, The correct answer is **"bars."**
